name: Hookhilt Reliquary
description: Presents both hook swords crossed at the chest, which doubles as the first guard of the school's form.

name: Snarlverdict
description: Brushes one edge across the forearm and follows at once with the other on the same line.

name: Delugecleat
description: Advances in the measured pace of a pair, one foot and one hook moving together.

name: Thrall Hookguard
description: Presses one hook against the other around an enemy blade and holds it steady with qi.

name: Clevistroth
description: Slips the wrist past an enemy's hooking tug and returns the tug through the other hook.

name: Venom Disarm
description: Beats an enemy blade with one hook and cuts the loosened hand with the other.

name: Thrallcleat
description: Folds both hooks on opposite sides of an arm so the limb is held between two bends.

name: Seasonyank
description: Drives forward in paired cuts that force the opponent back along a single corridor of ground.

name: Rending Hooklock
description: Wedges both hooks into the enemy guard from opposite sides and pries it open for a thrust through the centre.

name: Destiny Hooktip
description: Weaves both hooks through a school sequence of bind, pull and thrust that closes on a single opponent from both sides.

name: Steelgrapnel
description: Stands with the hooks set on two parallel tracks before the body, one high and one low.

name: Haemal Twistaway
description: Chops from the high track at the shoulder while the low hook holds the guard.

name: Steel Swordhook
description: Sweeps the low hook across the shins as the high hook keeps the enemy's blade busy.

name: Devout Hookneck
description: Pivots both hooks on the lead foot to turn a cut from either track off the body.

name: Millstone Snarl
description: Crosses the tracks over an enemy blade so it is gripped like a rail between two bends.

name: Cleatedict
description: Moves the leading hook into the guard and the guarding hook into the cut within one breath.

name: Ethereal Hookcurve
description: Slips off the enemy's line onto a parallel one and cuts at the exposed side.

name: Thrall Pulldown
description: Locks the enemy arm between both tracks and lifts it away from the body, laying the ribs open.

name: Matchless Hookcrook
description: Sends cuts down the high and low tracks in alternation, never leaving either unguarded.

name: Pulsar Cresthook
description: Folds both tracks inward onto the throat line while the enemy's weapon is held outside them.

name: Destiny Hookspine
description: Runs the school's long sequence across both tracks, each hook alternately binding and cutting until the opponent is held.

name: Undaunted Hookspine
description: Cups both hooks before the belly with the guard blades up, taking the cuts like a basin takes rain.

name: Haemalyank
description: Pours quick short strikes with the hooked tips like rain falling on the same spot of the arm.

name: Hookend Heraldry
description: Walks in a slow circle around the foe with the hooks level, closing the circle by a half step each turn.

name: Deluge Hookcurve
description: Receives a cut in the cup of the hooks and lets it overflow past the shoulder.

name: Thrallyank
description: Draws a trapped sword up and over the rim of the hooks and flings it aside.

name: Sovereign Snarl
description: Skims the tip along the rim of the opponent's guard and slices the fingers on it.

name: Sigil Cresthook
description: Scoops an enemy's leg in the cup of the hooks and tips him over onto his back.

name: Bedrock Hookguard
description: Raises cuts higher with each stroke like a rising waterline, driving the foe up and back.

name: Rending Hookend
description: Spins both hooks about the target in a narrowing whirl that pulls every limb in toward the centre.

name: Hookhilt Decree
description: Fills the cup of the hooks with qi through the school's basin form, then overflows it in one release of cuts and pulls.

name: Hooktip Pledge
description: Stands with the hook held low like a stream bed, ready to lead any attack along its course.

name: Illustrious Hookcrook
description: Thrusts straight out with a sudden welling of force at the point.

name: Spectral Hooklock
description: Steps down in stages like water over a weir, each landing lower than the one before.

name: Squall Hookneck
description: Follows the curve of an incoming cut and guides it round the bend of the blade.

name: Sigil Pulldown
description: Hooks an enemy sword mid-swing and draws it with the current of its own motion.

name: Vigorcleat
description: Throws a series of fast broken cuts that jostle like rapids along the opponent's arm.

name: Surging Disarm
description: Drifts behind a lunge and hooks the lead arm as it passes the hip.

name: Sigil Swordhook
description: Joins both hooks over the enemy's hilt hand and clasps it, then cuts the wrist as the grip opens.

name: Sigilcleat
description: Hooks the lead leg from beneath and drags it as water undercuts a bank, dropping the foe.

name: Seasonsnarl
description: Spreads cuts wide across the whole front, filling every side the foe could step to.

name: Quenched Disarm
description: Narrows both hooks onto the enemy's guard like a gorge closing, then tears through the pinched arm.

name: Resonant Season Cresthook
description: Carries the school's long cycle from spring to mouth, each stage a bind or a cut that feeds the next.

name: Clevispledge
description: Hangs both hooks from the hands like talons, ready to seize whichever side the foe opens.

name: Quenched Hooklock
description: Rakes the left hook down the front of the enemy's guard arm in a long cut.

name: Haemal Snarl
description: Rakes the right hook up the inside of the thigh as the foe turns from the left.

name: Vigor Hookspine
description: Glides in on a low line with the hooks held out wide, closing the gap before the foe reacts.

name: Sacrosanct Hookneck
description: Folds both hooks across the body like wings and bats a blow aside.

name: Yankseal
description: Seizes the sword arm at wrist and elbow with one hook each and holds it rigid.

name: Steelcleat
description: Lands on the held blade of the foe and drops the weight of the body into a cut.

name: Hooktip Decree
description: Wheels round the foe in rising and falling cuts that come from a different angle every time.

name: Pulsar Yank
description: Plunges forward in a flashing dive through the opposing blades and drives both barbs into the shoulders.

name: Orchestral Destiny Swordhook
description: Runs the school's dive through its three phases of approach, seizure and kill with two talon-like hooks.

name: Sainted Hookguard
description: Draws the breath to the belly in a calm guard with both hooks lowered, steadying the body's centre.

name: Haemaldisarm
description: Thrusts upward and straight, leaving nothing between point and target.

name: Squall Hookcrook
description: Steps along an even line with the shoulders level, so that the hooks never rise or fall.

name: Peal Hookcurve
description: Lets a cut break on the still surface of the hooks with no ripple passing to the body.

name: Millstone Hookend
description: Holds a sword in the hooked bend while the core's qi gathers behind the grip.

name: Unrivaled Hookhilt
description: Cuts on the beat of the pulse so the stroke lands as the foe's guard drops.

name: Disarmseal
description: Heaves a hooked foe off his feet by driving the pull from the belly and not the arms.

name: Subjugating Twistaway
description: Presses the hooked bend straight down the enemy's line and drives the point through the opening.

name: Snarlcrown
description: Delivers clear unbroken cuts in a long succession that give the foe no cover to hide in.

name: Thrall Hookend
description: Binds an enemy weapon in the hooked bend with a Core-level hold that no pull can break.

name: Grand Volition Pulldown
description: Draws qi from the formed core through the school's circuit of hooked binds, pulls and cuts, ending in one decisive stroke.

name: Cleatseal
description: Stands braced as against a steady wind, the guard blade turned into the push.

name: Vigor Hookcrook
description: Cuts with the wind against the opponent's back arm, adding speed to the stroke.

name: Windborne Yank
description: Strides forward leaning into a headwind, head low and hook held in front.

name: Squallgrapnel
description: Slips through the lull between blows and parries the one that follows.

name: Authoritative Twistaway
description: Tugs an enemy blade sharply with the wind behind the pull and breaks its line.

name: Steel Hookspine
description: Slices fast enough that the edge whistles, drawing the eye while the other hand pulls.

name: Stalwart Hookguard
description: Throws out the cloak or sleeve as cover and hooks through it at the foe.

name: Bedrock Hookhilt
description: Turns with a shift of the wind and cuts the arm that has just missed.

name: Millstone Hookcurve
description: Whips the hook around the leg and throws the opponent in the direction of the wind.

name: Bedrock Hooklock
description: Presses a chain of cuts in the steady push of a strong wind that never lets the foe settle.

name: Grapnelseal
description: Wrenches the enemy's sword arm to the windward side with a drawn hook and thrusts into the open ribs.

name: Tenet Disarm
description: Runs the school's cycle of wind-turned binds and cuts in which each stroke answers the last gust.

name: Bedrock Hooktip
description: Stands with the hook set on a fixed line through the opponent's centre and holds it.

name: Inferno Twistaway
description: Thrusts along the held line without a wasted motion, the point arriving where the eyes had aimed.

name: Evanescent Hookneck
description: Crosses the enemy's bearing in two steps and takes a new line behind it.

name: Vising Pulldown
description: Takes a reverse bearing on the foe's weapon and hooks it as it swings through.

name: Parity Cresthook
description: Parries along the bearing so the point returns to the same line at once.

name: Vigor Twistaway
description: Corrects a drift in the opponent's line with a short cut at the wrist.

name: Sigilsnarl
description: Locks a sword on the bearing and drags it along the line, carrying the user inside the reach.

name: Volition Hookend
description: Lays rank after rank of cuts along the held line until it is the only way the foe can go.

name: Storied Yank
description: Reaches far down the bearing with the hooked point and drags the target onto it in one stroke.

name: Hookneck Verdict
description: Lays three bearing lines in the school's sequence so that each hook strike closes the last open one.

name: Adamant Hooktip
description: Raises the hook across the face in the school's sworn guard, held as a promise to the wind.

name: Haemal Swordhook
description: Cuts once from the sworn guard with the whole weight of the shoulder behind it.

name: Evanescent Swordhook
description: Takes a step that holds the line and never gives ground on the oath's bearing.

name: Sigildisarm
description: Locks the hook on the enemy blade and holds it as an oath is held, unmoving.

name: Faithful Cresthook
description: Presses a parry through the cut with a gale's force and drives the blade down.

name: Thunderclap Pulldown
description: Tears the enemy's grip from the hilt by hooking the fingers and wrenching.

name: Vigor Hooklock
description: Parries once, binds once and slices once, the three beats forming one oath of response.

name: Authoritative Hookhilt
description: Pulls a locked sword down the sworn line and thrusts under the arm that held it.

name: Majestic Snarl
description: Chains pledged cuts in gale-like succession, each driven by the one before.

name: Quenched Hookcrook
description: Anchors the barb in a seam of armor and holds it there until the oath-line pull tears it open.

name: Resonant Destiny Yank
description: Runs the school's course of vow, bind and release, each stroke bound to the oath of the guard that began it.

name: Hookguard Seal
description: Holds the hooked tip at the heart then lowers it onto the bearing in the school's salute.

name: Peerless Disarm
description: Slices along the line of the bearing without allowing the point to drift.

name: Squallyank
description: Shuffles the feet sideways along the bearing without turning the hips from the foe.

name: Yankvow
description: Holds the bound blade on the oath line with a calm steady qi flow.

name: Squall Hookcurve
description: Checks a cut on the bearing and returns a thrust along the same line.

name: Peal Hooklock
description: Beats the enemy blade onto a new course and sets the next stroke along it.

name: Crushing Hookspine
description: Seizes the enemy arm by reckoning its path in advance and thrusts into the bound elbow.

name: Seasondisarm
description: Marches forward in measured cuts, each on the oath's pace, driving the foe off his ground.

name: Sigil Yank
description: Fixes the hook on a distant enemy and hauls himself along the bearing to close.

name: Orchestral Snarl
description: Closes the school's form by holding both bearing and oath at once through the final bind and thrust.

name: Steelclevis
description: Stands wide on open ground with both hooks lowered to either side, a stance without a rear to protect.

name: Quenched Hookhilt
description: Slashes in a flat sweep across the waist of the nearest foe.

name: Vigor Snarl
description: Runs low across the ground with the hook skimming just above it.

name: Pall Cresthook
description: Blocks a heavy cut and pushes it out wide with the crescent guard.

name: Disarmvow
description: Rolls the hook around an enemy blade in a half circle and traps it.

name: Squallcleat
description: Spirals the blade in a corkscrew cut that curls past the guard hand.

name: Peal Disarm
description: Whips the hook round on a trailing arm and catches the back of the enemy's knee.

name: Bedrock Hookend
description: Dodges a cut as if blown aside and hooks the weapon arm as it passes.

name: Unbending Hooktip
description: Sweeps both feet from under a standing enemy by hooking behind the ankles.

name: Gloomsnarl
description: Rushes forward with a driven chain of cuts that gives the foe no standing room.

name: Snarlseal
description: Passes through an enemy line in a burst of motion, hooking and tearing aside each weapon on the way.

name: Choral Season Hookcrook
description: Runs the school's open-ground sequence from the wide stance through sweep, hook and throw to the final burst.

name: Ironclad Hookguard
description: Draws a slow breath into the core while holding a loose open guard with the hook low.

name: Thunderclap Hookspine
description: Cuts with a loose wrist that whips through the guard as a reed in the wind.

name: Squall Swordhook
description: Glides over open ground without any rhythm the foe can read.

name: Yank Covenant
description: Warms the grip with qi from the core so the hook holds a blade through any twist.

name: Deluge Hookcrook
description: Parries without a fixed line, turning each cut to the side it is least expecting.

name: Vigorclevis
description: Runs the length of the foe's reach and cuts the near arm at the moment of passing.

name: Authoritative Hookcurve
description: Heaves the hooked foe round on the end of the blade and releases him into open ground.

name: Bedrock Twistaway
description: Throws a storm of hooked cuts in every direction from the centre of the body.

name: Imperious Cresthook
description: Locks the hooks around a weapon with a tide of core qi that holds it motionless in the bend.

name: Symphonic Destiny Hooklock
description: Draws on the formed core through the school's full sequence in open ground, ending in one open unguarded stroke.
